parameters.content:
## Google Shopping Price Comparison & Deal Finder

**Actor:** [Google Shopping Price Comparison & Deal Finder](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/google-shopping-price-comparison-and-deal-finder)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-shopping-price-comparison-and-deal-finder.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `queries` (array)
- `productIds` (array)
- `category` (string)
- `countryCode` (string)
- `languageCode` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `condition` (string)
- `minPrice` (integer)
- `maxPrice` (integer)
- `onSale` (boolean)
- `freeShipping` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `title` (Product)
- `price` (Price)
- `currency` (Currency)
- `merchant` (Merchant)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `reviewCount` (Reviews)

description: Google Shopping price comparison: runs the Google Shopping Price Comparison & Deal Finder Apify Actor, returns title, price, merchant, rating, reviewCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
